definitions.gloss: gyuhi; sweetened soft mochi; Turkish-delight-like rice cake
definitions.explanation: A soft, pliable type of mochi made by kneading glutinous rice flour with sugar and starch syrup. Used extensively in traditional Japanese confections.

examples.japanese: {求肥|ぎゅうひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{餡|あん}→餡：10220_an⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: To wrap bean paste in gyuhi.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{求肥|ぎゅうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦もちもち→もちもち：05260_mochimochi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食感|しょっかん}→食感：06636_shokkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧だ。
examples.english: This Japanese sweet is characterized by the chewy texture of its gyuhi.

examples.japanese: {求肥|ぎゅうひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{違|ちが}って→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経|た}って→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{硬|かた}く→硬い：01116_katai⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧にくい。
examples.english: Unlike regular mochi, gyuhi doesn't harden easily even over time.

notes:
A type of soft, elastic mochi used as a key ingredient in many traditional Japanese confections (⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧). Made from ⟦{白玉粉|しらたまこ}→白玉粉：24188_shiratamako⟧ (glutinous rice flour) or ⟦{餅粉|もちこ}→餅粉：24971_mochiko⟧ kneaded with sugar and ⟦{水飴|みずあめ}→水飴：27566_mizuame⟧ (starch syrup).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {求肥|ぎゅうひ}⟦{餅|もち}→餅：03900_mochi⟧: gyuhi mochi
- {求肥|ぎゅうひ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧: to wrap in gyuhi
- {求肥|ぎゅうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make gyuhi

USED IN:
- ⟦{大福|だいふく}→大福：12173_daifuku⟧: daifuku — mochi stuffed with sweet filling
- ⟦{雪見|ゆきみ}→雪見：14829_yukimi⟧だいふく: yukimi daifuku — ice cream wrapped in gyuhi
- ⟦{練|ね}り{切|き}り→練り切り：28742_nerikiri⟧: nerikiri — molded Japanese confections

ETYMOLOGY:
Originally written as {牛皮|ぎゅうひ} (cow skin) because the soft, stretchy texture was likened to cow hide. The characters were later changed to {求肥|ぎゅうひ} to avoid the unappetizing association.
